＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)

[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is suspended, none of your opponent's Digimon can attack players.
